 Coram : Sarang V. Kotwal, J.

Date : 17 January 2024
 P.C. :

1. The Applicant is seeking anticipatory bail in conne
 with C.R.No.653 of 2023, registered at Ghatkopar Police Station,
 Mumbai, on 04.08.2023, under section 420 r/w. 34 of the Indian
 Penal Code.
2. Heard Mr. Milan Desai, learned counsel for the  applicant and Ms. Sharmila Kaushik, learned APP for the State.
3. The F.I.R. is lodged by Vishal Agrawal.
He has stat  that, he was knowing one Lokesh Solanki since past six years.

sentences.text: They gave phone  number of one Mohan.
On the next date, Mohan called the  informant and told him that his associate would come at Kurla and  would show him the gold.
The informant went there.
One person  named Rajesh having mobile phone No.7600873659 came there  and showed him a 100gms. 24 carat gold biscuit.
He told the  informant that price was Rs.4,50,000/-.
The informant agreed to  pay Rs.4 lakhs.
The said person Rajesh called the applicant to  Vidyavihar on the next day.
The informant went there on  27.05.2023 at about 3.00p.m.
One Rahul came there and asked  the informant to show the money.
The informant showed him  money.
In the meantime, one four wheeler came there.
There were  five persons in that car.
One of them got down and removed that  amount of Rs.4 lakhs and went towards Kurla.
The informant  could not chase them.
He called Mohan and told about the  incident.
After about half an hour, Rajesh called him and told him  to come near Charni Road and told him that the money would be  returned.
The informant and his friend Lokesh went to Charni :

4. Learned counsel for the applicant submitted that, in  this case the investigation is over and the charge-sheet is already  filed.
In the entire investigation there is no reference as to how the  present applicant was connected with the alleged offence.
He  submitted that the prosecution case is that the said Rajesh was  none other than the present applicant, however, there is no  material to substantiate that allegation.

He further submitted that,
 there is one phone number referred to herein above attributed to  Rajesh, but there is no connection of the present applicant with the  said phone number.
5. Learned APP submitted that, the co-accused has given  his statement and has mentioned that said Rajesh was none other  than the present applicant.
She submitted that the main accused  were constantly in touch with the applicant.
6. I have considered these submissions and I have  perused the statement allegedly given by co-accused Mohsin.

sentences.text: In the meantime, the informant had given one application to the  police on 14.06.2023.
However, in the entire investigation carried  out so far, there is no material against the present applicant, as  mentioned earlier.
Therefore, his custodial interrogation is not  necessary.
But the applicant will have to co-operate with the  investigation.

7. Hence, the following order :
 ORDER i) In the event of his arrest in connection with C.R.No.653 of 2023, registered at Ghatkopar Police Station, Mumbai, the applicant is directed to be released on bail on his executing P. R. bond in the sum of Rs.30,000/- (Rupees Thirty Thousand Only) with one or two sureties in the like amount.
ii) The Applicant shall attend the concerned Police 5 of 5 19-aba-130-24 Station from 29/01/2024 to 31/01/2024 between 1.00p.m. to 5.00p.m. and thereafter as and when called.
The applicant shall cooperate with the investigation.
iii) The Application is disposed of.

(SARANG V. KOTWAL, J.)
